question: 50 glass bottles were purchased for ₹50, and 28 glass bottles broke in transit. The trader sold the remaining glass bottles at ₹5.80 each. Find his profit.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Cost Price (CP)** = ₹50.

Remaining bottles = 50 − 28 = 22 bottles.

Total **Selling Price (SP)** = 22 × 5.80 = ₹127.60.

**Profit** = SP − CP = 127.60 − 50 = ₹77.60.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹77.60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Total Bottles = 50, CP = ₹50, Broken = 28, SP per bottle = ₹5.80.
Formulas: Profit = SP − CP
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd56accb76bb5f8f3aa2e96f6ee0a863f888844e20bb3cfa6e2dc55974b0947b.png] 
⇒ Total **Cost Price** = ₹50.
⇒ Number of **undamaged bottles** = 50 − 28 = 22.
⇒ Total **Selling Price** = 22 × 5.80 = ₹127.60.
⇒ **Profit Amount** = 127.60 − 50 = ₹77.60.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹77.60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Cost Price

When items are broken or lost in transit, the cost of those items is absorbed into the remaining stock, effectively increasing the CP per unit of the remaining items.

Profit and Loss

Profit occurs when SP > CP. Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.
